S1: Figure S1. Quality control and batch integration of scRNA-seq data. (A) UMAP embeddings colored by genes detected, total UMI counts, mitochondrial percentage, and doublet score. (B, C) QC metrics across the 32 stomach samples, colored by treatment–response group (B; grey, not selected for the response comparisons), and across the 38 non-stomach samples, colored by tissue site (C). (D) UMAP colored by sample identity before and after Harmony batch correction. (E) Scrublet doublet scores across all cells.
S2: Figure S2. Cell type annotation. (A, B) Canonical marker genes across the 12 major cell types with T/NK merged (A), and across the T/NK subtypes (B). Dot size, fraction of expressing cells; color, mean expression scaled within each gene; the key beside (B) applies to both panels. (C) Cell-type composition of the 38 non-stomach samples. Color mapping matches Figure 1C.
S3: Figure S3. CEACAM5/6 validation and meta-program characterization. (A) Dotplot of marker genes across 9 epithelial sub-clusters. (B) Spearman correlation between CEACAM5 and CEACAM6 in an independent cohort (PRJEB25780; BayesPrism-deconvolved epithelial expression; NR, n = 33; R, n = 12), colored by R versus NR. (C) Spearman correlation between CEACAM5 and CEACAM6 in TCGA-STAD (n = 410; BayesPrism-deconvolved epithelial expression). (D) Proportion of CEACAM5/6-high (Epi_CEACAM5/6+) epithelial cells in primary tumor samples after adjusting for tumor content (residuals of the per-sample proportion regressed on the mean tumor score), R versus NR (n = 4 per group). Mann–Whitney U test. (E) Proportion of CEACAM5/6-high (Epi_CEACAM5/6+) epithelial cells in liver metastasis samples, R versus NR. Mann–Whitney U test. (F) Gene signature heatmap of the 5 NMF meta-programs (S-MP1–S-MP5), showing the top 10 genes per program. (G) Jaccard similarity heatmap of the per-sample NMF programs (n = 116) across all gastric tumor samples, grouped into meta-programs MP1–MP5. (H) Kaplan–Meier overall survival curves for CEACAM5 (left) and CEACAM6 (right) deconvolved epithelial expression, high versus low, in TCGA-STAD (median split, n = 183 per group). Log-rank test.
S4: Figure S4. CD8+ T cell sub-cluster characterization, exhaustion markers, and adaptive lineage composition. (A) Dotplot of marker genes across 8 CD8+ T cell sub-clusters. Dot size, percentage of expressing cells; color, mean expression. (B) UMAP of CD8+ T cells colored by PDCD1 (PD-1) expression (log-normalized). (C) UMAP of CD8+ T cells colored by HAVCR2 (TIM-3) expression (log-normalized). (D) UMAP of CD8+ T cells colored by the composite exhaustion (Tex) score used to annotate the exhausted state (Table S3; see Methods). (E) Minor-state composition of the CD4+ T, CD8+ T, NK and B cell compartments across treatment–response groups.
S5: Figure S5. Spatial transcriptomic validation across all GSE251950 samples. (A–E) Spatial maps across all 10 gastric cancer samples showing: (A) CEACAM ratio (proportion of CEACAM5/6-high epithelial cells among total epithelial cells per spot, GraphST deconvolution), (B) deconvolved monocyte/macrophage fraction, (C) total epithelial fraction, (D) distance to the nearest stromal region, and (E) distance to the nearest immune region. (F) Stacked bar chart of deconvolved cell type proportions per sample (GraphST). Color mapping matches Figure 1C.
S6: Figure S6. Immune module proportions across treatment–response groups. (A–E) Immune module proportions in pre-treatment and post-treatment stomach samples. Left, pre-treatment R (n = 4) versus NR (n = 4); right, post-treatment R (n = 5) versus NR (n = 6). IM-T/NK/DC (A), IM-MoMac (B), IM-Mixed (C), IM-Neutrophil (D), IM-B/Plasma (E). Two-sided Mann–Whitney U test; exact P values shown (*, P < 0.05). Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to 1.5 × the interquartile range and open circles mark values beyond them.
S7: Figure S7. CD274 (PD-L1) expression across additional cell types in post-treatment samples. (A–I) Sample-level CD274 (PD-L1) expression in post-treatment R versus NR samples for cell types not shown in Figure 5: CD8+ T cells (A), CD4+ T cells (B), NK cells (C), B cells (D), Plasma cells (E), Mast cells (F), Neutrophils (G), Endothelial cells (H), and Pericytes (I). Of the 5 R and 6 NR samples, those with fewer than 20 cells of a given type were excluded; the n per group is printed under each panel. Two-sided Mann–Whitney U test; exact P values shown (*, P < 0.05). Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to 1.5 × the interquartile range and open circles mark values beyond them.
S8: Figure S8. Epithelial metaprograms and CEACAM5 compared with CEACAM6. (A) S-MP4 and S-MP5 scores across treatment–response groups. (B) Percentages of CEACAM5-only, CEACAM6-only, double-positive, and double-negative pre-treatment epithelial cells by response (n = 4 per group). (C) CEACAM5, CEACAM6, and summed IHC staining in responders and non-responders (n = 4 per group). Two-sided Mann–Whitney U tests; exact P values are shown.
S9: Figure S9. Density-stratified spatial analyses and independent bulk validation. (A, B) Section-level CEACAM-ratio coefficients for distance to immune-rich regions (A) and stroma (B) across local epithelial-density tertiles. (C) Representative spatial section showing CEACAM-high and CEACAM-low spots across density tertiles and their five nearest other immune-rich spots. (D, E) Association between deconvolved epithelial CEACAM5/6 and ESTIMATE immune score in TCGA-STAD tumors after adjustment for ABSOLUTE tumor purity (n = 395). Two-sided P values and 95% confidence intervals are shown.
S10: Figure S10. Monocyte/macrophage identity and the specificity of the NF-κB signature. (A, B) Monocyte and macrophage signature scores and marker expression across the seven monocyte/macrophage states. (C) Hallmark TNFα/NF-κB enrichment in post-treatment non-responders versus responders across 13 cell types. (D) Inflammatory cytokine expression in epithelial cells and monocytes/macrophages from post-treatment non-responders. (E) Sample-level NFKB1 regulon activity in post-treatment monocytes/macrophages (R, n = 5; NR, n = 6; two-sided Mann–Whitney U test).
